services.value: Provides trace level PFAS analysis (e.g., LC-MS/MS and GC-MSD) and compliance PFAS drinking water testing using EPA methods 537.1 and 533. Also offers water treatment R&D support including adsorbent evaluation, rapid small scale column tests, pilot-scale testing, funnel concept/modeling, and waste management/destruction approaches using ionomer adsorbents and solvent-free desorption.
